_comment: Qwen-Image-2.1 instruction-based image EDIT (int8_convrot files) — background replacement. Source photo is uploaded as the reference image and fed into the text encoder's `images` slot; prompt carries the edit instruction. Latent comes from the text encoder (output 2), NOT an EmptyLatentImage. Denoise tuned for foreground preservation.

inputs.prompt: Replace the ENTIRE background of this photo with a tree fort (treehouse) built high in a dense tropical rainforest canopy overlooking the ocean. The tree fort has warm wooden planks and a rope railing, hung with glowing string lights, surrounded by lush green leaves framing the view. Beyond the canopy, a turquoise ocean and distant coast under warm golden-hued light. Keep completely UNCHANGED: the person's legs with rainbow-striped socks on the couch, the black fluffy dog on its gray bed, the couch, the rug, the wooden door frame and handles, and everything in the foreground. Match the cozy, warm, dimly-lit night mood and muted earthy color palette of the original.
inputs.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, deformed legs, extra limbs, distorted dog, misshapen couch, misplaced furniture, text, watermark, signature, changed foreground, moved sofa, broken window glass
